name: A Bad Egg
summary: Curgle Cranklehop speaks of the eggs that cannot be saved, which will never hatch.

sections.title: An Egg Beyond Saving
sections.body: Some hippogryph eggs cannot be saved, and a bad egg is one that will never hatch. It is Curgle Cranklehop who deals with such eggs.

sections.title: What Becomes of It
sections.body: Curgle takes the egg so that it is disposed of properly. Not every egg can be saved, Curgle says, and you should not be discouraged but try again with another egg from Feralas.

aliases: who do i give bad egg to

faq.answer: No. A bad egg is one that cannot be saved and will never hatch.
